03 — Projects

Selected Projects

01

Night Patrolling Robot

Built a Wi-Fi controlled robot operable via mobile phone for small-scale security and military surveillance. Demonstrated potential applications in disaster recovery and autonomous patrolling operations.

Wi-Fi · Robotics
02

Energy Harvesting From Footsteps

Developed a prototype using piezoelectric sensors to convert mechanical energy from footsteps into electrical power. Target applications include powering streetlights and wearable devices sustainably.

Piezoelectric · IoT
03

Emotion Detect Studio

Real-time system that analyses audio signals to detect human emotions using signal processing and embedded machine learning. Enables intelligent applications like mood-based music recommendation and human-computer interaction.

ML · Audio DSP
04 — What I Do

How I can help you

01 —

Embedded Systems Design

From 8051 microcontrollers to Arduino-based prototypes, I design and implement embedded systems that bridge hardware and real-world applications — including programming in Embedded C and circuit-level integration.

02 —

Hardware & Circuit Development

Hands-on design, simulation, and prototyping of electronic circuits using Proteus, Multisim, and MATLAB. Experienced in soldering, assembly, and quality testing for real-world hardware setups.

03 —

Telecom & Networking

Applying fundamentals of communication systems, the OSI model, and 4G/5G technologies to understand and contribute to modern network design. Experienced with industrial automation via PLC and SCADA systems.

04 —

Audio Signal Processing & ML

Through building Emotion Detect Studio, I gained hands-on experience in audio feature extraction (MFCC, RMS Energy, Zero Crossing Rate), real-time waveform analysis, and applying embedded machine learning models — transfer learning & CNN — to classify human emotions from raw audio signals. I also built the full dashboard UI for live visualisation of signal intelligence.
